name: Generous
overview: Scripture reveals that generosity is a blessed and Christ-honoring practice rooted in giving to others, especially the poor and weak. Proverbs 22:9 highlights the blessing upon those who share their bread with the needy, while Luke 6:38 promises abundant return for those who give with a generous heart. Jesus teaches in Luke 12:33 to prioritize heavenly treasures through acts of almsgiving, and Acts 20:35 reminds believers that it is more blessed to give than to receive, encouraging support for the vulnerable as an expression of faithful labor.
